scripts.bundle:worklet: bare-pack --preset mobile --out worklet/app.bundle worklet/detector.worklet.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('worklet/bundle.js','export default '+JSON.stringify(fs.readFileSync('worklet/app.bundle').toString('base64'))+';')"
scripts.bundle:probe: bare-pack --preset mobile --out worklet/probe.bundle worklet/probe.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('worklet/probe-bundle.js','export default '+JSON.stringify(fs.readFileSync('worklet/probe.bundle').toString('base64'))+';')"
scripts.build:android:docker: docker build -f Dockerfile -t ba-estaciona-android-builder . && mkdir -p artifacts && docker run --rm -e BUILD_VARIANT=debug -v "$(pwd)/artifacts:/output" ba-estaciona-android-builder
